sources.citation: IIT-EnergySystemModels; institutional contact Andres Ramos, Universidad Pontificia Comillas. Open Stochastic Daily Unit Commitment of Thermal and ESS Units (openSDUC), official repository snapshot 951369aad1615fc6c2281d7bd350ded393096f3a, accessed 2026-10-17. No dataset-specific DOI confirmed.
institutional_affiliations: Instituto de Investigacion Tecnologica (IIT), Universidad Pontificia Comillas
sources.model_scope: Official documented 16-generator case in openSDUC/16g with 17 CSV input/dictionary files, bundled Python/Pyomo model and documentation. Model describes stochastic UC, operating reserves, renewable/demand scenarios and energy storage including pumped hydro and batteries; day/week time representations. Classification follows publisher documentation, not independent data inspection.
upstream_caveats: Emission reporting or CO2-cost input must not be relabeled as an emissions-cap constraint.
Upstream solver examples including Gurobi do not certify this project's COPT/Gurobi integration.
Package metadata GPLv3+ classifier differs from root AGPLv3 LICENSE; keep original source and license together.
No CSV parameter content was parsed and no upstream program was executed.

sources.title: OPTIT / University of Bologna CHP-CHCP UC testing materials: paired plant description and 2022 daily inputs
sources.version: Two pinned version-specific Zenodo records, both published 2024-03-26
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for both official records
sources.license_evidence: Both Zenodo records and both DataCite registrations explicitly identify cc-by-4.0, retrieved 2026-10-17.
sources.citation: Valerio Di Felice, Luca Giuliani, Angelo Gordini (2024), Dataset for testing unit commitment models of CHCP plants, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10875471. Valerio Di Felice, Caterina Tamburini, Angelo Gordini (2024), Block-oriented description of a fictional CHP generation plant for unit commitment testing, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10875998. Both Zenodo, published 2024-03-26.
sources.model_scope: Author-prepared fictional but realistic combined heat, power and cooling inputs, described as 365 JSON files for 2022, together with a separately published block-oriented CHP plant description that explicitly links to these inputs. Heat/cooling demand and electricity buy/sell and gas prices are documented. Two complementary records grouped as one source family, not two independent grids or 365 independent plants.
upstream_caveats: The daily time-series archive alone is not a complete standalone electric-grid UC benchmark; use with the companion plant description.
Completeness of plant parameters, time-step resolution, model import and feasibility are not verified in this collection stage.
Retain upstream CHP and CHCP naming distinction; no assumption that all device modules are active.
